title: 12月7日关键日：香港指数30扩50，AI估值缺口能否填补
speaker: Angela Chang

segments.en: You mentioned a few minutes back, right, before we came on air, December 7 is a key date.
segments.zh: 您几分钟前提过，在节目开始前，12月7日是个关键日期。

segments.en: We have an index change in Hong Kong, why is it relevant right now to what you're doing?
segments.zh: 香港市场有个指数调整，为什么现在与您的工作相关？

segments.en: Why would have expected so long, because you know, has a tech or has an index overall, actually for long, there is a valuation gap between China's economic fundamental, especially
segments.zh: 为什么预期这么久？因为科技或整体指数长期存在估值差距，尤其与中国经济基本面相关。

segments.en: related to AI cap hacks or AI breakthroughs, actually, have not reflected into this index, right?
segments.zh: 与AI资本开支或突破相关的，其实尚未反映到该指数中，对吧？

segments.en: It's not an AI index. Yeah, so I think it's related to the index overhaul.
segments.zh: 这不是AI指数。所以我认为这与指数 overhaul 有关。

segments.en: In general, so we are very glad to see the index expansion from 30 to 50.
segments.zh: 总体而言，我们很高兴看到指数从30只扩展到50只。

segments.en: I think in the future, we expect the index or tech index to be like the one-stop position
segments.zh: 我认为未来，我们预期该指数或科技指数成为一站式配置。

segments.en: that the global fund can buy AI related, especially application, those names on the one roof.
segments.zh: 全球基金可以一站式买入AI相关，尤其是应用领域的标的。

segments.en: So that's the future attractiveness, but it's more like a medium to long-term.
segments.zh: 所以这是未来的吸引力，但更多是中长期的。

segments.en: I think in the near term, near terms, more like liquidity or market sentiment thing.
segments.zh: 我认为短期内，更多是流动性或市场情绪因素。
